children: New Delhi, Sept. 8 -- HFCL share price has been on a strong uptrend of late. The stock has surged over 260% in the last six months on the BSE. On Tuesday, 8 September, HFCL shares jumped 5% to hit an intraday high of Rs.255, just a whisker below its upper circuit of Rs.255.05. Notably, the stock hit its 5% upper circuit in its previous two consecutive sessions. In three consecutive sessions, including Tuesday's intraday high, the stock has climbed nearly 16%.

title: HFCL Share Price: Over 260% jump in 6 months - what's the reason and what investors should do?
